findings.summary: `rules += active_promos(now)` mutates the list returned by the now-cached `load_rules` in place, so promos are appended on every quote, applied repeatedly, expired promos persist, and other callers (e.g. pricing/api.py:18) see the polluted list.

The lru_cache is per process and `save_rules` only calls cache_clear() locally, so other workers/hosts serve stale rules until restart (no TTL); also cache_clear() wastefully clears all tenants' entries.
The last line of `test_save_invalidates_cache`, a dangling `save_rules(..., value=12)`, has no assertion and leaves state behind in the shared DB for other tests.
